public_preflight.registered_tldr: TLDR: First qualify native Jev on complete synthetic maps, then compare early report order with social/private decisions and retained/reset state against pooled and deterministic baselines. Measure whole-map error bounds, missing responses and paired history disagreement. Exploratory fixed-evidence pilot; no adaptive scouting or changed-weight claim.
public_preflight.run_tldr: S0-A1 compares paired early report order under social/private decisions and reset/retained maps in six worlds against pooled and deterministic baselines. Measures whole-map error bounds and history divergence; an exploratory fixed-evidence pilot, not adaptive scouting.
